gemini._comment: API key is read from GEMINI_API_KEY environment variable

confluent._comment: API credentials are read from CONFLUENT_API_KEY and CONFLUENT_API_SECRET environment variables

firms._comment: MAP_KEY is required for FIRMS area API. Get a free key from https://firms.modaps.eosdis.nasa.gov/api/ and set FIRMS_API_KEY environment variable

google_maps._comment: API key is read from GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY environment variable
